title: National Camp for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 Begins in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: India's junior badminton hopefuls have gathered at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati for an intensive coaching camp ahead of the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Conducts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the coaching standards across India, directly impacting the development of future Indian badminton stars.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) successfully organized its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur, concluding on September 23rd, 2026, to upskill national coaches.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships at NCE Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is vital for the preparation and selection of India's promising young players for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A dedicated coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: This change directly impacts the composition of India's women's doubles contingent for the prestigious World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced a change in the women's doubles pair for the ongoing selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Implemented in Domestic Junior Tournaments and Nationals
indian_angle: This significant rule change in domestic junior events will impact player strategies and development across India's U-13, U-15, and U-17 categories.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
